notes:
Need to search first.I couldn't write these notes, because I wasn't able to read any of the sources.

**What went wrong:**
1. **My first attempt failed.** I tried to open the Jeremiah 35 pages directly on enduringword.com, biblehub.com (Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit Commentary), preceptaustin.org and netbible.org. The fetch tool blocked all six because it only opens web addresses that have already come up in a search.
2. **The searches never ran.** When I tried to search first, I had hit this turn's limit on the search tool. My other tools can't reach the internet.

So I have no page content and no URLs to cite. Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge, so I haven't written any verse notes.

**What should work next time:** Ask again, ideally in a new message, and I'll do it in this order:
1. Search for the verse-by-verse commentaries: Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary, Precept Austin.
2. Search for the different traditions' teachers on the passages they're most likely to discuss: the abstinence question (vv. 6–8), the obedience lesson (vv. 13–16) and the promise in v. 19.
3. Search for NET Bible notes and Catholic and Orthodox readings of the Rechabites.
4. Read the pages those searches return and write the notes verse by verse, with a URL for each point.

If you have specific page links already, sending them in your message lets me open them directly.
